remarks: Welcome to your own peaceful escape! This adorable cottage sits on a private road between McClean and Terrace, offering a quiet setting while still being right in the heart of it all. Step outside to your own small yard-perfect for morning coffee or unwinding in the evening-and enjoy the convenience of plenty of parking. With great restaurants and shopping just minutes away, this home truly has it all.
